item.text: The route pattern uses a wildcard that matches nested paths, so `/teams/*/badge.png` also admits `/teams/west/drafts/badge.png`. Visibility currently excludes dot-prefixed paths and the `private` segment only. I’ll add `drafts` to that segment exclusion.
